    edge_count = (degree_sum - sum(degrees_and_xs[i][0] for i in range(n))) // 2

    # Create a list to store the degree and XOR sum for each vertex
    degrees = [0] * n
    xors = [0] * n

                neighbor = xors[i]

                xors[i] = 0
                degrees[neighbor] -= 1
                xors[neighbor] ^= i
                adj_list[neighbor].remove(i)
